title: Moonah Links Christmas Market and Tree Lighting
summary: Moonah Links holds a Friday Christmas market in Fingal with local gift stalls, live music and a tree lighting. The resort says entry and parking are free.
description: The Christmas Market and Tree Lighting takes place at Peppers Moonah Links Resort in Fingal on Friday 27 November 2026, from 4pm to 8pm. The resort lists free entry and parking.

provenance: The resort’s official programme lists Friday 27 November, 4pm to 8pm, and free entry and parking. Its contact page verifies the street address. The exact tree-lighting time, booking requirements and accessibility are not stated.
editorVerdict: Good for a short family stop as well as a browse for Christmas gifts. The organiser hasn’t published an exact tree-lighting time.
editorNote:
Moonah Links lists local artisan and Christmas gift stalls, food, drinks and live music for its Friday evening market. It also lists a Santa meet-and-greet and face painting. The tree lighting is part of the evening programme; the resort does not give it a separate start time.

The market runs from 4pm to 8pm on Friday 27 November at Peppers Moonah Links Resort, 55 Peter Thomson Drive in Fingal. The organiser says entry and parking are free. It has not published individual stall times or a full list of vendors, so don’t plan around a specific stall or activity unless you check first.

This listing is for the Friday market. Saturday’s acoustic set and the resort’s Christmas Day lunch are separate events. If the weather is uncertain or you need an accessible route from the car park, check with the resort before travelling.
